title: The scores Google published for Gemini 4 Carbon
intro: Google’s 28 October announcement gives four figures for Carbon. Move across them. Each one is a different test, so the numbers are not a single scale.
note: These are Google’s figures, from its own post. The three cybersecurity scores were measured without guardrails. The index score is Google’s reading of Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0. This is not an independent rerun. Carbon is available to a subset of cyber defenders, not generally.
